volunteerExperiences.description: Assist nurses and physicians as needed/requested; assist patients and families. Observe procedures, shadow nurses and physicians. Stock supplies, answer SICU phones, update census boards, etc. Observe and assist (as requested) physicians and nurses providing direct patient care at hospital Level I trauma center; re-stock trauma area following patient transfer. Required thorough knowledge of Standard Precautions for infection control; confidentiality, patient privacy and HIPAA laws.

Attend clinical staffings with psychiatry Residents and Fellows. Observe clinical interviewing of patients and families; didactic instruction/discussion regarding differential diagnosis, medications, and ethical and current issues in psychiatry and medicine. Population: children and adolescents with mild to moderate mental illness, learning disabilities, autism spectrum, and/or school-related disturbance.
